cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Copy .env to new clone
print("=== Copying .env to new clone ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria/.env /opt/areloria_new/.env")
# Update the ecosystem.config.cjs to point to new clone path
print("\n=== Using new clone for PM2 ===")
# Simply rename old and swap
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("mv /opt/areloria /opt/areloria_old && mv /opt/areloria_new /opt/areloria")
print("Swapped directories")
# Start PM2 with new location
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start /opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 8 && pm2 list")

print("\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Check health
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health")
print("\nHealth:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
PYEOF
